description: Change only some fields of the draft, using the current revision. `changes` is a JSON Merge Patch over the SiteDocument: objects merge, null removes a field, and arrays (services, gallery, pages, sections) are replaced whole. Does not change the live publication.

changes.description: Only the fields to change, e.g. {"phone":"0400 000 000","hours":"Mon–Fri 8–5"}

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Set a random key and reuse it exactly when retrying, so a retry is not applied twice

name: update_site
